name: Tianjin Benefo Tejing Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Tianjin Benefo Tejing Electric Co., Ltd. operates in the power equipment industry in China and internationally. The company offers electric control distribution accessories and molds, such as terminal blocks, switch, heavy duty connectors, isolators, transmitter, switching power supply, and relay; electromagnetic wire, copper busbar, and coil; and low voltage electrical products, including baili smart, molded case, miniature, and intelligent universal circuit breaker, as well as automatic transfer switch.
